events.name: Hackathon
events.description: A high-energy innovation sprint for teams turning sharp ideas into useful, impactful products.
rules: Build in the given time window
Use original work and disclose APIs
Present a working demo to the jury

events.name: CTF
events.description: Find the flags through cryptography, web security, forensics and reverse engineering challenges.
rules: No attacking infrastructure outside the arena
Share flags only with your registered team
Highest score wins; time breaks ties

events.name: E-Sports
events.description: Strategy, teamwork, reflexes and skill collide in the ultimate competitive gaming arena.
rules: Check in 30 minutes before the match

events.name: Treasure Hunt
events.description: Decode clues, overcome challenges and race across campus to uncover the final treasure.
rules: Solve clues without damaging campus property

events.name: Workshop
events.description: Learn from practitioners, explore emerging technologies and turn theory into hands-on experience.
rules: Seats are first come, first served
Carry a laptop for the practical session
Complete the feedback form for a certificate

speakers.name: Dr. Meera Joshi
speakers.bio: Leads student innovation programs and helps early ideas become useful products.

speakers.name: Arjun Mehta
speakers.bio: A security educator who makes complex systems easier to question, test and protect.

speakers.name: Riya Kapoor
speakers.bio: Designs digital experiences where technology feels clear, generous and human.
